messages:
sre-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx and streaming write latency in region us-west2. metric: streaming_push_5xx_rate spiked from 0.05% to 2.3% over 3m. paging oncall ben_oncall.

ben_oncall: I'm on it. first look: tailing proxy logs shows connection reset and backpressure on push frame writer. overall cpu on inference nodes normal, but grpc proxy pool at 95th percentile qlen.

carla: seeing same. long-lived SSE connections accumulating. prefix cache eviction also increased token latency for streaming sessions. nonstreaming endpoints look fine.

ben_oncall: impact: customers using streaming chat may see truncated responses or reconnects. ramp started ~09:12Z.

ops_lead: we need a graceful mitigation to lower system load fast. options: 1) global disable push frames, 2) region-scoped disable for us-west2, 3) apply connection rate limits. prefer region-scope to limit blast radius.

alice: agree region disable first. can we flip the feature flag for streaming push to false for us-west2 and fallback to chunked polling? that'll cause connection resets but clients will reconnect to regular responses.

ben_oncall: plan: 1) set feature flag streaming_push=false for prod region us-west2 2) apply temporary quota 'streaming-concurrency' to 2 per user for 10m 3) post status page and notify top 5 customers with active streams 4) monitor metrics for 15m then reassess.

carla: sounds good. commands below - use rictl to avoid manual console drift.

```
# flip streaming push off for region us-west2
rictl feature set --env prod --flag streaming_push=false --scope region:us-west2 --reason 'mitigate pushframe surge 2026-03-15'

# apply throttling policy to limit concurrent streaming sessions per API key
rictl policy set --env prod --policy streaming_concurrency_limit --value 2 --scope region:us-west2
```

ben_oncall: executing step 1 now. invoking change window 09:30Z. tagging deploy with incident id INC-2187654321.

deploy-bot: rollout started: feature/streaming_push_off -> prod/us-west2. CI checks passed. change id: ch-7891. watching for rollout errors.

ben_oncall: rollback plan ready: re-enable flag if error rate doesn't drop or if reconnect storms create larger CPU spike. rollback command is same with true.

support_pager: prepping customer messages. short note to send to affected customers: 
- what: temporary disable of streaming responses in US-WEST2 to improve latency/throughput
- impact: active streaming sessions may be dropped; normal non-streaming requests unaffected
- ETA: expected restore in 30-60 minutes pending stability checks

ops_lead: also update public status page with 'degraded streaming in us-west2' so users see ongoing action.

alice: monitoring queries:
```
# watch 1m 95th streaming write latency and push 5xx rate
select percentile(streaming_write_latency_ms,95) from metrics where region='us-west2' and service='streaming' since 1m
select rate(streaming_push_5xx_rate,1m) from metrics where region='us-west2'
```

carla: watching redis backlog and proxy connection queue: redis list lengths up for prefix_cache_queue and push_writer_queue. if backlog doesn't drain in 5m after flip, switch additional ingress shaping.

ben_oncall: rollout complete. deploy-bot reports 100% of targets updated.

deploy-bot: rollout finished: ch-7891 -> success. no immediate errors from config service.

alice: initial signs: streaming push 5xx rate trending down to 0.4% within 2m, 95th write latency dropped from 1200ms to 240ms. connection drops increased briefly as clients reconnected then stabilized.

support_pager: sent short notices to top 5 customers, posted status page update. copy: 'We're temporarily disabling streaming push frames in us-west2 to stabilize response latency. Connections may be interrupted; non-streaming APIs unaffected. We will update when restored.'

ops_lead: good. keep throttling policy for now. lower blast radius by reducing streaming burst tokens: apply token-bucket refill change to 30s.

carla: applied token-bucket change. command: rictl policy set --env prod --policy streaming_burst_refill --value 30s --scope region:us-west2

ben_oncall: monitoring for 15m window. if metrics stable for 15m, we'll start staged re-enable: enable push for 10% of edge nodes then 25% then 50% with checks between.

alice: quick note for oncall rotation: I will be primary until 10:45Z then hand to ben if still ongoing. annotate incident channel with handoff.

ben_oncall: thanks. preparing post-incident notes: cause hypothesis: backlog at proxy layer due to an unusual client pattern creating many small streaming sessions; prefix cache churn exposed inefficient push writer under load. next actions for SRE/research: collect client user agents and session keepalive patterns, create a sim test, and tune push_writer concurrency.

support_pager: after-action comms: include known affected customers, timeline, mitigation steps, and recommended client reconnection backoff guidance.

ops_lead: agreed. keep the streaming flag off until we confirm sim tests and a patch to push writer concurrency. at that point we will document rollback and staged re-enable.

ben_oncall: last check in for now: streaming 5xx at 0.2%, 95th latency 210ms, redis backlog draining. I'll leave incident open and hand to alice at 10:45Z for monitoring window.

alice: acknowledged. taking over monitoring. will update channel for re-enable steps or rollback if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
